Monitor points and eligibility strictly through Raiku Staked SOL's verified official domain on Solana and bookmark authentic portal links. Cost: zero additional cost. Time: 5 minutes.

Log all transaction hashes, unstake locked assets, observe unbonding cooldowns and redeem native tokens from Raiku Staked SOL on Solana, and revoke all smart contract allowances. Cost: standard network fee to withdraw and revoke. Time: 10 minutes.
